stem: How do the stage directions and Joelle's speech in line 2 contribute to the audience's understanding of the plot?

options.label: A
options.text: They characterize Joelle as desperate to be the center of attention.

options.label: B
options.text: They present the problem that Joelle is worried about Lina’s silence.

options.label: C
options.text: They reveal that Joelle’s blaming of Lina is the source of a conflict between them.

options.label: D
options.text: They introduce characters with opposite interests who will eventually clash.
